zotero.abstractNote: Alcohol use is linked to distributed structural brain alterations, but population-level alcohol-related neurobiology remains difficult to quantify. We tested whether deep learning-derived MRI representations capture reproducible variation in alcohol consumption severity and converge with clinical and biological markers. Representations were extracted from gray-matter volume maps in the German National Cohort (NAKO; N ≈ 28,000). Ridge-regression scores were derived from structural MRI to estimate alcohol consumption severity, measured with the Alcohol Use Disorders Identification Test-Consumption (AUDIT-C). Models were trained in NAKO, externally validated in UK Biobank (N ≈ 25,000), evaluate..
